snippet.title: "I don't see myself alive in 5 more years" - IShowSpeed
snippet.description:
@IShowSpeed didn't start as the number one streamer in the world. He started as a kid in his bedroom (@cristiano fan) making funny videos for almost nobody. But somewhere between those early streams and performing at halftime at the 2026 World Cup, something changed. The audience grew. The pressure grew with it. Sixty million people watching your every move means sixty million reasons to never slow down.

What most people see is the energy, the chaos, the entertainment. What they don't see is the weight behind it. The constant pressure of maintaining an audience of millions. The awareness that one bad stream, one slow week, one moment of being human — and it could all disappear.

Speed knows this better than anyone. He's talked about it openly. The risks he takes aren't accidents — they're part of what keeps sixty million people coming back. And he's fully aware of what that costs him.
At the end of this video, he gives a speech that's hard to forget. A guy who has everything the internet could give a person — and has come to accept that he can't see himself alive five years from now.

This is what success looks like when nobody talks about the price.
